scenes.title: A team of specialist agents.
scenes.subtitle: Triage, routing review, handoff writing, and follow-up planning.

scenes.title: Each agent has a clear role.
scenes.subtitle: Reusable instructions and a selected model connection.

scenes.title: One workflow coordinates the process.
scenes.subtitle: Validation → specialist sub-workflows → browser action → verified handoff.

scenes.title: Review the routing before taking action.
scenes.subtitle: An independent agent review followed by AI verification.

scenes.title: Require multiple conditions to pass.

scenes.title: Parallel IF gates, arranged vertically.
scenes.subtitle: Every matching specialist workflow runs; their results join when both finish.

scenes.title: Give every branch its own conditions.
scenes.subtitle: Combine conditions and choose the specialist sub-workflow for each branch.

scenes.title: Schedule execution inside the workflow.
scenes.subtitle: The Schedules tab is already linked to this workflow.

scenes.title: A customer asks a question.
scenes.subtitle: A fictional duplicate-payment enquiry enters through the website.

scenes.title: The enquiry enters the workflow queue.
scenes.subtitle: The website receives a tracking ID for this execution.

scenes.title: Follow execution from the queue.
scenes.subtitle: The submission links directly to its workflow run.

scenes.title: Triage selects the right specialist.

scenes.title: AI verification checks the decision.

scenes.title: The browser completes the assignment.

scenes.title: Verify the result in the service desk.
scenes.subtitle: Assigned to Maya Chen in Billing. The saved result matches the enquiry.

scenes.title: Both matching agent workflows succeed.

scenes.title: Inspect the complete workflow run.
